candidate_state: planned publication from the locally validated release-preparation commit

internal_measurement.evaluator: material-only release validation; no new evaluator adopted
internal_measurement.results: Workspace release tests, rustfmt, clippy, opening-book release tests, a native material-only USI smoke, and local WebAssembly package generation passed. Version 0.4.1 improves fail-closed evidence, search correctness, behavior-preserving HalfKP update throughput, and opt-in Lazy SMP diagnostics without adopting a new default search policy or evaluator. No general playing-strength claim is made.

external_opponents.configuration: No external engine, evaluator, weights, labels, Suisho5-derived scores, or Suisho5-derived opening positions are used as release evidence for v0.4.1.

known_limitations: No new NNUE checkpoint is bundled or adopted, and this release makes no general playing-strength claim.
New Lazy SMP policies remain opt-in experiments; the default LazyFlags value is unchanged.
Parallel search can vary by scheduler; deterministic diagnostics require one thread and SpecTopN=0.
The WebAssembly package is distributed as a GitHub Release asset and is not published to the npm registry.
External HalfKP inference remains optional and requires a separately obtained, license-compatible nn.bin file with its own provenance and operating scale.
